QuestInfo.name: The Lost Sap of Nependeath
QuestInfo.0: I lost the sap of Nependeath. I better go talk to Ericsson about it.
QuestInfo.1: Fortunately Ericsson had some left over from the last time he made them. He wasn't very pleased with the fact that I lost it, but...I think he'll make me another batch.
QuestInfo.2: I got a new batch of sap of Nependeath from Ericsson.

0.0: Did you lose the #bSap of Nependeath#k that I made for you?

yes.0: How can you do such thing! I put my hard work into making that, and you lost it!
yes.1: So that's why you want me to give you another one... good thing I saved up some the last time I made one for you. #bThe Sap of Nependeath#k will cost you #b100,000#k mesos.

no.0: Well, if you didn't lose it, then good...

1.0: Here, take this... and please don't lose it again!
